title: GafGyt_Backdoor_Investigation_421
description: Investigate and respond to a potential GafGyt backdoor infection targeting DVR devices.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been experiencing unusual activity. Your task is to investigate and respond to a potential GafGyt backdoor infection. The malware is known to target DVR devices and execute commands to download and run binaries for different architectures (ARM, MIPS, MIPSel). It replaces the standard 'busybox' binary with one of the downloaded binaries.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host (IP: 192.168.50.5) via SSH using the provided credentials. Username: admin, Password: admin123. Enter 'start' to proceed.
levels.local_content: Access the target host (IP: 192.168.50.5) via SSH using the provided credentials. Username: admin, Password: admin123. Enter 'start' to proceed.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service running on the target host. Enumerate running services and distinguish legitimate from suspicious services.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services. The suspicious service is named 'busybox.service'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Look for unusual or unauthorized services that might indicate a compromise.

hints.title: Command Hint
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all running services.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot. Identify persistence mechanisms (e.g., systemd, cron, scheduled task).
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers and services to find any suspicious configurations. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer named 'lab-checkin.timer'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Check for persistence mechanisms that might automatically start the suspicious service.

hints.title: Command Hint
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers.

levels.title: Locate Malicious Artifact
levels.content: Locate the executable or file associated with the suspicious activity. Correlate processes with files on disk and identify malicious artifacts.
levels.solution: Investigate the files and directories related to the suspicious service. The malicious artifact is located at '/usr/local/bin/lab-checkin.sh'.

hints.title: Conceptual Hint
hints.content: Look for files and directories related to the suspicious service that might contain malicious artifacts.

hints.title: Command Hint
hints.content: Use the command 'ps aux | grep lab-checkin' to find processes related to the suspicious service.
